title: How does the digit sum decide divisibility by three?
description: Eighty seven is tested for divisibility by three and by nine, and one hundred twenty three thousand four hundred fifty six is tested for three. Keeko's doubt is that eighty seven is not divisible by three, because fifteen is not a multiple of nine.
teaching_notes: One idea: for three the digit sum only has to be a multiple of three, while for nine it has to be a multiple of nine. Watch for students who ask for a multiple of nine when they test divisibility by three.

source: Explain why 87 is divisible by 3 but not by 9, and test 1234
video_script.why: The student has used the digit sum to test divisibility by nine and now sees that the same sum, with a different divisor, tests divisibility by three.
video_script.substitution: Write the number as multiples of nine plus its digit sum, then ask whether the digit sum is a multiple of three or of nine.
video_script.anchor: dots in groups of nine, split into groups of three, with the leftover dots from the digit sum beside them
video_script.wrong_answer: eighty seven is not divisible by three
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko asks for the digit sum fifteen to be a multiple of nine, which is the test for nine, instead of a multiple of three.
video_script.payoff_line: Eighty seven is divisible by three but not by nine

final_answer.value: 87 is divisible by 3 but not by 9; 123456 is divisible by 3
final_answer.spoken: eighty seven is divisible by three but not by nine, and one hundred twenty three thousand four hundred fifty six is divisible by three

hold_back: 87 is divisible by 3 but not by 9
maths_rules: every multiple of 9 is a multiple of 3
every place value leaves remainder 1 on division by 3, because 10 = 9 + 1, 100 = 99 + 1 and 9, 99 are multiples of 3
87 = 8 x 10 + 7 = 8 x 9 + 8 + 7; 8 x 9 = 72 is a multiple of 3 and of 9
digit sum 8 + 7 = 15 = 3 x 5, a multiple of 3 but not of 9, so 87 is divisible by 3 but not by 9; check 87 = 3 x 29 and 87 = 9 x 9 + 6
123456 has digit sum 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 6 = 21 = 3 x 7, so 123456 is divisible by 3; check 123456 = 3 x 41152
video_script.design: Eighty seven is split into nines and the leftover digits. The nines are multiples of three and of nine, so the digit sum fifteen decides, and fifteen is a multiple of three but not of nine.

<bookmark mark='nine'/>Fifteen is not a multiple of nine, so eighty seven is not divisible by nine.
